Exam Date & Time: 06-Jun-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2025  
  SUBJECT: ELE 1071/ELE_1071 - BASIC ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY  
  (MAKE-UP)  
  BASIC ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY [ELE 1071-CHM]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Determine the equivalent resistance between terminals A and B.                                       (3)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1B)                Using Superposition theorem, determine the current through 12 Ω resistance.                          (7)  
  
  
  Page 1 of 3

Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)             A single-phase ac circuit with applied voltage v(t) = 200 sin 377 t volts, draws a current of i(t) = 8 sin   (5)  
  (377t - 30ᵒ) amperes. Find (i) impedance of the circuit (ii) Circuit parameters (iii) Power and power  
  factor associated.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2B)             A 100 Ω resistor and a 0.5 H inductor are connected in series with a 230 V, 50 Hz AC supply. If a        (5)  
  capacitor has to be added in parallel to the supply, calculate the value of the capacitor to enhance the  
  overall power factor to 0.9 lagging.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3A)   Find the average and rms value of the waveform shown below.                                                                  (4)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)             An unbalanced three phase star connected load, is supplied with a three phase four wire 415V, 50             (6)  
  Hz, RYB supply. If ZR= 6 + j8 Ω, ZY = 12 - j5 Ω and ZB = 20 Ω, calculate the neutral current. Take VRN  
  as reference.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)             Two-watt meters are connected to measure three phase power of a balanced star connected load,          (4)  
  drawing a phase current of 20 A, at 0.7 power factor lagging. Determine the reading of the watt meters  
  if the supply voltage is 400 V.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis" Page 2 of 3

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4B)                   A ring of 30 cm mean diameter with an airgap of 1 mm is made using a cylindrical mild steel rod of             (6)  
  diameter 2.5 cm. When it is magnetized with a coil carrying a current of 6 A, the flux produced in the  
  core is 3 mWb. Taking relative permeabilities of mild steel as 2000, calculate  
  i) Flux density within the core  
  ii) Total reluctance of the ring  
  iii) Number of turns in the coil  
  iv) Magnetomotive force  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5A)                   The combined inductance of two coils connected in series is either 1.2 H or 0.2 H, depending on the            (3)  
  relative directions of the current in the coils. If self-inductance of one of the coils is 0.4 H, determine  
  i) Self-inductance of the other coil.  
  ii) Mutual inductance.  
  iii) Coupling coefficient.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5B)                   Clearly indicating the voltage levels stage, explain briefly the role of a transformer in an Electric Power (4)  
  System.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5C)                   With a neat block diagram, explain the working of a digital energy meter.                                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
